headline: Best ground mounts in Palworld 1.0
title: Best Ground Mounts in Palworld | Necromus, Paladius, Hartalis | Palworld Guide
video_script: Which ground mount is best in Palworld one point zero? At the top, guides name Necromus and Paladius, the legendary pair, and Hartalis, a raid boss you summon at the Summoning Altar. Necromus is one of the fastest ground mounts and has a double jump, while Paladius trades a little speed for a triple jump. And early in the game, Direhowl is the one to get, because its saddle is one of the first you can craft. What do you ride? Comment below!
description: Best ground mounts in Palworld 1.0: Necromus (top speed, double jump), Paladius (triple jump), Hartalis (raid boss) and Direhowl as the early-game pick with one of the first saddles.
